doc.title: Rossano Sportiello interviewed by Monk Rowe, New Hartford, New York, October 2, 2015 [interview 1 of 2]

title: Closing remarks
summary: Thanks and goodbyes before the evening concert.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: I can’t think of a better way to wrap this up. You have been totally fascinating.

Thank you. It was a pleasure. And I have to admit that, as I told you before, that I love to tell my musical story on the piano to the audience. Whenever I get the opportunity of expressing the thoughts behind that musical story, I love to do it.
Well I’m looking forward to hearing your musical thoughts at the piano as well, tonight.
